conclusion: With Bluetooth discovery paused, two same-workload reads measured 144,712–148,540 B/s versus the preceding hub baseline of 54,026 B/s (2.68–2.75x). Full browser OPFS and Wyse OS boot timings remain unmeasured.
limitations: Synthetic Node source is not the browser OPFS path.
The first measurement used direct native USB; the second used a USB hub.
Samples are not a full Wyse boot or sustained write qualification.

Mac was kept unlocked and awake during the successful radio-policy measurements; individual run rates are not a universal guarantee.
